messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: api-gateway-prod-us-west — sudden spike in 502/504s from edge. 5xx rate 7.8% (60s), p95 latency 1.9x baseline. Pager: @oncall. https://telemetry.example/alerts/2801239999
Samira (oncall): ack. jumping in. Anyone seeing related deploys or cert rotations? @Theo
Theo Rivera: No infra deploys in last 30m. I see a rise in TLS handshake errors in edge-proxy logs — 'tls: handshake failure' followed by upstream timeouts for longest streaming routes (/v1/stream). snippet: `edge-proxy[pid]: 2026-03-15T14:02:13Z ERROR tls: handshake failure from 10.12.3.45`
EdgeOps Pager: Also seeing a spike in connection reset (RST) to runtime-ingress for streaming websockets. Connection resets peaked at +300% in the last 2m. CPU/mem normal. Link: https://dash/edge/handshakes/2801
Support Bot: Support queue: 12 new tickets flagged high — customers report requests failing with 502 on bulk embedding calls. Top impacted orgs: AcmeCorp, FableHealth, CritterMaps (IDs and details in support UI)
Liam (CS): AcmeCorp escalating via CSM — they reported a ~30% failure rate for batch embeddings since ~13:58 UTC. They're on dedicated capacity in us-west.
Samira (oncall): initial hypothesis: partial cert rotation on edge LB caused some nodes to reject client TLS, cascading into backend failures causing gateway 502s/504s. Theo, can you confirm cert rotation events? Check certmanager and LB rollout.
Theo Rivera: Checking cert-manager events... there was a cert rotation job at 13:56 with a 3-node rolling update: `cert-rotate-job-2026-03-15T13:56`. I see 2/3 LB nodes reported 'certificate not yet available' for ~40s during rotation. Logs: `watcher: certificate unavailable, retrying`.
Samira (oncall): that aligns. If some edge nodes had expired/incorrect certs, TLS handshakes would fail and clients might get 502s. But why would we also see 504s? Maybe long-polling requests retried and then hit overloaded backends.
Theo Rivera: right — failed TLS on some edges caused clients to reconnect, increasing load on remaining edges and runtimes. Also seeing connection saturation to runtime-ingress, timeouts appear as 504 in gateway logs. sample: `2026-03-15T14:01:58Z gw: upstream timeout for /v1/stream`.
EdgeOps Pager: short-term mitigation: mark the 2 bad LB nodes out of service at the edge layer (manual drain) to stop TLS failures. Command to mark OOS: `curl -X POST https://edge-control/api/nodes/mark -d '{"node":"edge-12","state":"oos"}' -H 'Auth: $TOKEN'`
Samira (oncall): do that. Theo please roll back cert rotation if possible (revert to previous cert) or re-apply to fix missing cert files. Which is faster?
Theo Rivera: fastest is to re-push the cert to the 2 nodes and restart the edge-proxy process (no full rollback). I'll issue a parallel push. Patch command: ```for node in edge-12 edge-19; do scp certs/prod.pem $node:/etc/edge/cert.pem && ssh $node 'systemctl restart edge-proxy'; done```
Maya (ops-bot): Auto-scaler triggered +20% in runtime-ingress due to retries. We're holding scaling to avoid thrash. Current replica counts: runtime-ingress=18 -> 22 requested.
Samira (oncall): Support Bot, ping impacted customers with templated note: we're investigating a transient TLS/cert rotation issue affecting some requests, with partial mitigation underway. Mark severity P1 and give ETA 15m.
Support Bot: message sent to flagged customers. Ticket updates posted. Templates used: `incident_ack_cert_rotation`
Theo Rivera: cert push started to edge-12 and edge-19 now. Restarted edge-proxy on edge-12, logs show cert loaded. edge-19 still pending (scp timeout). Investigating network path.
EdgeOps Pager: while one node remains unhealthy, we should divert traffic away from us-west to us-east fallback for critical customers. Samira: request a temporary routing preference change for high-priority orgs.
Samira (oncall): executing traffic steering for AcmeCorp and FableHealth to us-east for 10m. Command: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/routes/steer -d '{"orgs":["AcmeCorp","FableHealth"],"prefer":"us-east","ttl":"600"}' -H 'Auth: $CP_TOKEN'`
Theo Rivera: edge-19 scp succeeded, edge-proxy restarted, handshake errors dropping. Handshake error rate back to baseline in 45s. Runtime timeouts falling as connections stabilize.
Samira (oncall): monitoring. p95 latency returning to normal. 5xx rate down to 0.9% (from 7.8%).
Liam (CS): thanked the team. Will hold off on customer update until we confirm full recovery. Customers acknowledged temporary routing.
Support Bot: all flagged tickets updated with status 'mitigated, monitoring'.
Samira (oncall): next steps: 1) sweep cert-manager logs to identify failed rotation cause (automation bug), 2) add pre-rollout healthchecks to cert rotation job, 3) run canary on 1 node before 3-node rollouts, 4) postmortem if root cause confirmed. Assigning owners: Theo -> cert fix/root cause, EdgeOps -> rollout policy change, Support -> customer comms. Handoff to oncall-night (Nico) at 15:30 UTC with summary below.
Samira (oncall): short summary for handoff: TLS cert rotation partially failed causing handshake errors on 2 edge nodes starting ~13:56 UTC, triggered connection storms and backend timeouts -> 502/504 spike. Mitigations: marked nodes OOS, re-pushed certs, restarted edge-proxy, steered critical org traffic to us-east. Status: recovered but monitoring. Handoff ETA: 15:30 UTC. @Nico (oncall-night) please take over.
ops-bot: Handoff recorded. Incident channel will remain open for 2h. Logs archived to https://incidents.example/2801239999
